verdict.rationale: Capacities documents robust offline-first behavior (works offline, syncs later, search and media caching work offline) [capacities-docs-13, capacities-docs-37, capacities-docs-42], but there is no evidence that data is stored as local files you can read without the app — it's a proprietary app store with sync, and 'ownership' is only achieved via a manual/scheduled Markdown+CSV export mechanism [capacities-docs-11, capacities-docs-31, capacities-docs-40], not native local-first file storage like Obsidian-style tools. Missing for 10: evidence of a native on-disk open file format usable without the app, and independent confirmation that offline mode has full feature parity (not just sync/search).
